here: Phases 8–12 are code-complete, but the P9 (NPC fleet replication) and P12 (campaign state) work reached the repo through a 2026-06-10 catch-up commit and has not yet been verified across two live game instances. The immediate next action is yours: deploy with scripts/deploy-to-test-clients.ps1, launch a host + guest, and walk the P9 / P12 smoke steps (shown on their cards). Once that passes, the next build is Phase 12b — QA Hardening (first in the hardening-first order; it also fixes a live silent-autoresolve-against-mirror bug).

attention.head: Manual smoke test pending — Phases 9 & 12 (and 10)
attention.body: The NPC-fleet-replication (P9) and campaign-state (P12) work landed via the 2026-06-10 catch-up commit and has not been human-verified in two live instances yet. Deploy with scripts/deploy-to-test-clients.ps1, launch host + guest, and run the P9/P12 smoke steps (on P9, P10, P12 cards). This is the gate before Phase 12b — the next build.

attention.head: Phase 13 is PARTIAL
attention.body: Procgen RNG forks, CoopRandom, and deep-space determinism are DONE. Remaining: extend the suppressor to base / encounter / deciv / war managers, add WORLD_DELTA subtypes (DECIV / OBJECTIVE_OWNERSHIP / GATE_ACTIVATED), host-authoritative pirate/Pather bases (CoopBaseAuthority), and write docs/starsector-runtime-limitations.md. See P13.

attention.head: Phase 24 rescoped INTO V1 (2026-06-10)
attention.body: Shared-faction colonies, industries, and raids are now V1 scope — one shared player faction (separate per-player factions stay out). It slots at build-order position 10, after 12c; raids (milestone 1) need no colony-lifecycle work. See P24.

attention.head: Phase 5 handshake checksums are placeholders
attention.body: File checksums are inert (the script sandbox blocks java.io hashing). Two installs with matching version metadata but differing jar contents connect silently. Real loadText-based hashing is a Phase 12b item.

attention.head: Guest transponder-off reactions regressed
attention.body: Phase 9’s NPC suppressor removed the guest’s local NPC sim, so fleets no longer react to the guest running dark. Not a bug in isolation — a documented gap; host-authoritative triggering returns with Phase 14.

attention.head: The plan was enriched on 2026-06-10
attention.body: The last doc change added the authoritative Phase Status Ledger, the hardening-first build order, new sub-phases (6b / 7b / 7c / 12b / 12c), rescoped Phase 24 into V1, and added post-V1 phases 25–29. Phase 7’s fast-forward verdict is partly superseded by 7b. When the ledger and a phase’s checkboxes disagree, the ledger wins.

phases.title: Scaffold
phases.summary: Creates the Starsector mod scaffold with Gradle, mod_info.json, jar output layout, CoopModPlugin and logging, no networking yet.
residue: Launch Starsector and confirm mod loads without coop stack trace

phases.title: Local Build Loop
phases.summary: Adds repeatable build, clean, and launch scripts plus dev docs and Gradle build-metadata manifest attributes.

phases.title: Net Pump Hello World
phases.summary: Adds a minimal java.nio TCP host/client service with a runWhilePaused frame pump and PING/PONG messages.
residue: Two-instance ping/pong smoke test paused and unpaused
phases.note: Netty superseded — shipped as plain java.nio (reflection sandbox-blocked); no jars/netty/

phases.title: Session State + Lobby
phases.summary: Adds explicit host/guest connection state and a minimal pre-handshake lobby over the existing TCP connection.

phases.title: Version + Mod Handshake
phases.summary: Adds version/mod-manifest handshake with iron-mode refusal, allocating canonical sessionId only on accept; mismatches reject with a diff.
residue: File checksums inert placeholder UNAVAILABLE:script-sandbox — real loadText hashing deferred to Phase 12b
phases.note: Checksums are placeholders; differing jar contents with matching version metadata connect silently

phases.title: Seed Lock
phases.summary: Shares a new-game seed/seedString and a structural sector fingerprint so host and guest procgen identical sectors, rejecting mismatches.
residue: Hardening gaps folded into Phase 6b (campaign identity, diagnosable fingerprint, seedData(long) deletion)

phases.title: Seed Lock Hardening
phases.summary: Adds a host-minted per-campaign UUID to the seed lock plus full canonical fingerprint dumps so mismatches are identifiable.
phases.note: Build-order position 2 (hardening-first).

phases.title: Time Lock
phases.summary: Host owns campaign pause/fast-forward/clock; guest mirrors pause via 5 Hz TIME_SNAPSHOT and has its local time input consumed.
phases.note: Fast-forward verdict (no public lever) partly superseded by Phase 7b's toggle-mode discovery.

phases.title: Fast-Forward Restore
phases.summary: Restores shared hold-Shift fast-forward as host-controlled 2x by forcing toggle mode and mirroring the fastForward field via MethodHandles.
phases.note: Build-order position 11; degrades to Phase 7 1x lock if handles fail.

phases.title: Clock Reconciliation
phases.summary: Guest-side reconciler converges the guest campaign clock to the host via bounded monotonic slew plus forward-only snaps during shared pauses.
phases.note: Build-order position 12; independent of 7b but absorbs its toggle-edge skew.

phases.title: Fleet Mirror
phases.summary: Represents the remote player as an AI-mode mirror fleet, replicating position and roster over UDP at 10 Hz with an always-visible presence marker.
residue: Two-instance movement smoke test verified 2026-05-29 (fleets mirrored in corvus)
Commit deferred, resolved by 2026-06-10 catch-up commit
phases.note: Netty dropped for java.nio (sandbox blocks Netty reflection)

phases.title: NPC Fleet Replication
phases.summary: Makes the entire NPC fleet population host-authoritative; the guest renders every NPC as a host-driven AI mirror and runs no native spawning or AI.
residue: PENDING two-instance smoke test: deploy build, launch host+guest, join a shared system, confirm guest shows identical NPC fleets (count, factions, rosters), fleets the host despawns disappear on guest, and guest's starsector.log never logs an independently-spawned NPC fleet
Landed via 2026-06-10 catch-up commit, not human-verified in two live instances yet
phases.note: Guest transponder-off faction reactions no longer fire (regression) — fix deferred to Phase 14

phases.title: Interaction Gate
phases.summary: Adds host arbitration of shared interactions (first-click-wins) and locks guest world interaction while blocked, showing a remote-player status message.
residue: PENDING two-instance smoke test: click the same market/fleet from both clients to confirm one accepted, other blocked
Commit deferred, resolved by 2026-06-10 catch-up commit

phases.title: Shared Pause Coordinator
phases.summary: Lets either player assert a shared pause via a host-computed OR-of-intents that rides the Phase 7 TIME_SNAPSHOT, keeping both clocks stopped together without desync.
residue: Two-instance smoke test confirmed in-game 2026-05-30 (guest screen pauses both, no phantom pause, host override asymmetry)
Commit deferred, resolved by 2026-06-10 catch-up commit

phases.title: Campaign State Replication
phases.summary: Replicates host-authoritative campaign state: shared reputation, mission/bar pools with claims, market contents/transactions, salvage outcomes, faction relations, and arbitrated abilities.
residue: PENDING two-instance smoke test: deploy build, launch host+guest, trigger a known rep change, race both players to accept the same bar/mission-board entry, confirm both see identical shop/officer stock and a guest purchase updates the host market, salvage a derelict on one client and confirm it is consumed (not re-lootable) on the other
Landed via 2026-06-10 catch-up commit, not human-verified in two live instances yet
Phase 12c residue: in-game extension points still unbuilt (bar/mission enumeration, weapon/fighter/officer/merc market capture, ability world effects)
Commit deferred, resolved by 2026-06-10 catch-up commit
phases.note: QA pass 2026-06-10 confirmed sound; fixes batched as Phase 12b, unbuilt wiring as Phase 12c

phases.title: QA Hardening
phases.summary: Batched cross-phase robustness fixes from the QA pass, including the live silent-autoresolve-against-mirror bug and inbound dispatch guarding.
phases.note: FIRST in remaining build order — immediate next work; fixes live silent-autoresolve-against-mirror bug

phases.title: Close the Phase 12 Extension Points
phases.summary: Wire the built-but-inert Phase 12 infrastructure: bar/mission pool enumeration, full market capture, and concrete ability world effects.
phases.note: Order slot 9; blocks Phase 19 QA pass

phases.title: Dynamic Terrain Authority + Random Fork List
phases.summary: Makes world content deterministic via RNG forks, then extends guest suppression and host-authoritative bases for the remaining runtime-random managers.
residue: Extend suppressor to base managers, EncounterManager, SensorGhostManager, DecivTracker, WarSimScript, PunitiveExpeditionManager, FactionHostilityManager
Host-authoritative pirate/Pather base reconstruction (CoopBaseAuthority, BASE_SET, guest reconcile)
phases.note: DONE: procgen forks (Misc/GateHaulerLocation/NamelessRock/AbyssalRogueStellarObjectEPEC), CoopRandom, deep-space determinism, forksJar build, classpath-prepend, full fingerprint match; generic TERRAIN_EVENT/CoopTerrainAuthority machinery cancelled.

phases.title: Own-Fleet Combat + Spectator Bridge
phases.summary: Solo own-fleet combat where the engaging player pilots locally while the other is paused and follows via a 2-5 Hz battle-status panel.
phases.note: No rendered spectator, no 60Hz stream, no combat speed lock, no joint combat (those cancelled/deferred to Phase 22)

phases.title: Combat Results + Campaign Reconciliation
phases.summary: Engaging client keeps its own spoils; battle campaign deltas (dead NPC fleets, shared rep) reconcile back into host authoritative state.
residue: battle smoke test both directions (spoils kept, kill propagates, rep converges)
phases.note: No 50/50 splitter in v1 (deferred to v2/v3 joint combat)

phases.title: Coordinated Saves + Guest Snapshot
phases.summary: Host owns canonical save; guest fleet snapshot embedded in host save's persistentData, and every host save triggers a deferred guest autosave.
phases.note: File export cancelled (sandbox-blocked I/O); snapshot is write-only disaster-recovery in v1

phases.title: Fleet Wipe Respawn
phases.summary: Detects player fleet wipe and respawns at last friendly station with a Wolf frigate and 5,000 credits, preserving skills and rep.
residue: spike: injection timing suppresses defeat text
phases.note: Skills/rep/officers preservation is automatic; no code needed

phases.title: Same-Dock Shared UI Locks
phases.summary: Both players can dock at one market but shop/submarket/bar screens are mutexed host-side; storage and private screens stay unlocked.
phases.note: Storage is per-player, never mutexed

phases.title: Two-Instance QA Pass
phases.summary: Final v1 sign-off: the exhaustive manual two-instance QA checklist plus preflight and log-tail scripts, fixing only checklist failures.
residue: run entire manual checklist across all phases
re-run Phase 20 WAN matrix + real-Internet/VPN session
phases.note: Runs LAST — prerequisite is every other v1 phase through Phase 20 complete (build-order position 14)

phases.title: Connectivity Hardening (LAN to Internet)
phases.summary: Hardens the coop transport so a localhost session works reliably between two households over the Internet with no gameplay change.
residue: spike: UPnP/dual-stack IPv6 on real routers
WAN QA matrix on shaped loopback
phases.note: Must ship before the final Phase 19 sign-off (Phase 19's checklist gains a WAN line depending on it).

phases.title: Multiplayer UX
phases.summary: Purpose-built multiplayer UI on official API only: in-campaign lobby with ready-up, connecting screen, desync dialog, and session stats.

phases.title: Co-op Piloted Battles + Tactical-Map Observer
phases.summary: Both players fight one host-side battle; the guest pilots its own ship via networked virtual keyboard, plus a drawn tactical-map observer.

phases.title: Public Release Packaging
phases.summary: Turns the developer-grade deliverable into a releasable mod with player docs, friendlier launch config, and release hygiene.

phases.title: Shared-Faction Colonies, Industries, and Raids
phases.summary: Both players manage the same colonies under one shared player faction: colony lifecycle, industry management, income split, and raids on NPC colonies.
phases.note: rescoped into V1 on 2026-06-10 (build-order position 10)

phases.title: Guest Time-Control Polish
phases.summary: Adds a host-owned allowGuestPause strictness toggle and consensual AND-of-intents shared fast-forward on top of Phase 11/7b.
residue: Part A gate + config + feedback + truth-table test
Part B FF_INTENT + coordinator AND logic + tests
two-instance smoke (both-tap FF, one-sided pending, screen-pause wins)
decide whether Part A ships at all
phases.note: Requires Phase 7b (CoopFastForwardLock); wants 20.6 session-intel + Phase 28 config surface

phases.title: Hyperspace Ambient-World Replication
phases.summary: Replicates slipstreams as outcome polylines and abyssal temporary systems via keyed EPEC re-execution so both players share hyperspace ambient content.
residue: M2 abyssal re-execution + three corrections + fingerprint exclusion + smoke
M3 abyssal lights/dire hints (decide at build)
document residual divergences + retire v1 accept-divergence entries
phases.note: Requires Phase 13 (suppressor + coop-forks.jar); builds on Phase 9 NPC mirrors + Phase 8 hyper position

phases.title: Multi-Guest Enablement
phases.summary: Generalizes the single-guest coop to a host plus 2-3 guests via a per-peer session table and gameplay arbitration, on Phase 20's N-ready transport.
residue: M2 claim ownership + ENGAGE_GUEST + N-way saves + per-peer grace
M4 full QA matrix incl one-link-shaped soak
decide cap (3 vs 2+config), grace semantics, mid-session join

phases.title: Coop Options & Player-Facing Configuration
phases.summary: Single home for player-facing config: a typed option registry, sandbox-safe file stack, host-policy sync to guests, and an in-game options page.
residue: decide LunaLib vs native, policy storage, pauseOnGuestScreens inclusion
phases.note: Milestone 1 has no prerequisites, lands with Phase 23; milestone 3 needs 20.6 CoopSessionIntel

phases.title: Campaign Motion Smoothness
phases.summary: Delivers smoothness via client-side mirror interpolation/dead-reckoning and link-decided adaptive cadence tiers, with no player-facing rate knob ever.
residue: spike: artifact characterization on shaped harness
M1 interpolator wired into mirror registry + tuning + commit
M2 cadence controller + tier surfacing + certification + commit
decide partner-mirror inclusion, tier set, blend/threshold values

Pirate/Pather bases host-authoritative; guest runs no base managers
Shared reputation converges after host-triggered rep change
Guest conceptual reputation baseline starts at 0

Salvage consumed on both clients; loot per-player

Host patrol stops guest for customs dialog resolved locally
